title: Echo guard
description: Short **quiet period** before capture so the mic does not pick up the assistant’s own speech.
content:
Echo guard

Short quiet period before capture so the mic does not pick up the assistant’s own speech.

What this is

Echo guard is a short quiet period before recording so your microphone does not capture the assistant’s own voice from speakers.

How to use it

  • After the assistant speaks, wait for Ready / listening phase before talking.
  • Use headphones for best accuracy in small rooms.
  • If you get false starts, reduce room noise or switch input device in system settings.

Notes and limits

Echo guard timing is automatic; there is no user slider in consumer builds.
